item.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several critical issues including missing imports, incorrect hex validation, and improper handling of different data types. The implementation also relies on an external 'rlp' library that is not available in the environment.
item.contract: Implement a complete and correct RLP encoding/decoding system that handles integers, strings, and lists correctly according to the Ethereum RLP specification. The implementation must not depend on external 'rlp' package and should properly handle hex strings, binary data, and all RLP encoding rules.

item.description: The keccak function attempts to use pysha3 library but doesn't handle the case when it's not available, and there's no fallback to hashlib.keccak_256. The test failures indicate that hashlib doesn't have keccak_256 attribute, which suggests the library isn't installed or not properly imported.
item.contract: Implement a robust keccak hashing function that properly handles the keccak_256 hash function availability. The implementation should either use the pysha3 library or fallback to hashlib with proper error handling and alternative methods when keccak_256 is not available.

item.description: The CLI command implementation is incomplete and doesn't properly handle command-line arguments or data parsing. The command fails because it's trying to execute with invalid parameters.
item.contract: Complete the CLI command implementation to properly parse command-line arguments and handle data encoding. The command should accept data input and str_mode parameters correctly and produce valid RLP-encoded output.

item.description: The rlp_encode function has several logical errors in handling different data types and hex strings. It's using a simplified approach that doesn't correctly implement the RLP encoding algorithm.
item.contract: Correct the RLP encoding logic to properly implement the Ethereum RLP encoding specification, including proper handling of single-byte data, short strings, long strings, and recursive list encoding.

item.description: The rlp_decode function has incomplete implementation and doesn't properly handle all RLP decoding scenarios. It lacks robust error handling for malformed data.
item.contract: Implement a complete and robust RLP decoding function that can properly decode all RLP-encoded data according to the Ethereum specification, with proper error handling for malformed inputs.
